cite_runs: Project 2025, the massive effort to create a transition plan for the new Trump administration, alludes to the unitary executive theory as a guiding principle in its 900-page planning document. Proponents say the theory rests on a plain reading of Article II of the Constitution, which says executive power “shall be vested in a President of the United States” and the executive “shall take care that the laws be faithfully executed.”
